verdict.rationale: gstack has no documented general-purpose bulk-operation feature. The closest evidence is batch-style workflows: /qa iterates over all found bugs and fixes each one with atomic commits (at tiered severity levels), /autoplan runs four review skills in sequence with automatic decisions, and /learn can search, prune and export accumulated learnings. missing for 10: an explicit capability to select and act on many arbitrary items at once, documented bulk or batch semantics beyond these specific skills, and independent or hands-on corroboration of batch use.
